cap_scope: User-authorized $25 per-trade screening ceiling only. No live/repository risk settings changed. 5% of initial $500. Remaining 1% portfolio ($5 initially), 2% daily pause and 10% equity-drawdown pause were not waived and are not simulated here.
original_risk_equity_cap_note: The original 0.5% equity per-trade restriction is superseded only for this isolated $25 diagnostic. No claim that the remaining account rules permit these lots.
data_scope: Same 30-day sample, all previously exposed. First15 observed NY sessions select variants; last7 are a reused chronological stability check, never an untouched holdout.
selection: Development only: n>=20, win rate>60%, PF_R>=1.2, positive meanR, positive development stress sumR; choose highest baseline meanR, then more outcomes, then lexicographic id. If none meet these criteria, retain RR2/none/full-window as no-improvement comparator.
validation: Freeze selected ids before executing last7. No re-selection after last7, alternate clock or stress results.
parameter_limits: Fixed signal lookback20 and structural candle extreme stops. Rewards 0.75/1/1.5/2R; filters none/EMA50 direction+slope/strong directional close; windows10-15 or10-12 NY. One position per trial. Maximum holding1h, flatten15:55. No stop compression, martingale or averaged entries.
execution: Same M1 bid bar model as previous test, next open60sec after completed signal, modeled ask=bid+spread. This revision rounds stress ask-spread up to tick and target distance toward entry. Stop-first collisions. Unknown commissions omitted, never treated as verified zero. Historical broker clock +3 primary, +2 sensitivity.
eligibility: Current lot step/minimum and multiplier only; historical applicability, fees, margin and quotes unverified. Dollar sizing is a pre-fee illustration, no account equity return.
confidence: Report Wilson binomial intervals descriptively; outcomes are dependent and selection is multiple testing, so intervals are not evidence of a >60% true win probability.

followup_and_balance_protocol.reason: Development-only morning1R variants exceeded60%, with only11 NAS and19 SPX outcomes. Both had positive stress development R. The n>=20 rule remains unchanged; no qualification or selected-winner replacement.
followup_and_balance_protocol.balance_method: Each row restarts at $500. Full30day rows carry cash continuously. Two conditional models: isolated $25 per-trade cap, and remaining-limits model with min($25,1% current equity), 2% daily pause and 10% drawdown halt. Current minimum lots/steps, frozen natural stops and modeled costs. Minute-open equity marks. Fees excluded and margin assumed feasible, never verified. No balance is a claimed real account return.

initial_screen_protocol.purpose: CFD transfer, unconstrained signal-outcome diagnostics; not a governed account backtest or strategy qualification

clocks.primary: fixed broker UTC+3, based on capture clock; historical mapping unverified
clocks.sensitivity: fixed broker UTC+2, a sensitivity case, not an estimate

initial_screen_protocol.split: No optimization. First 15 observed NY evaluation sessions are development, remaining sessions chronological check. All are now consumed exploratory data, not certified unseen holdout.
initial_screen_protocol.execution: Bid OHLC; modeled ask=bid+bar spread*point. Entries at next M1 open strictly 60 seconds after completed-bar decision. Exit quote sides respected. Stop first when both stop/target hit. Target prices get no favorable gap improvement. Market-stop gaps fill at adverse open. No tick path is inferred.
differences_from_repo: NAS100/SPX500 are broker CFDs, not MNQ/MES futures; no futures-performance claim.
Existing breakout/pullback signal kernel reused; all 3 exported timeframes tested at fixed default lookback20/reward2.
Baseline entry window10:00-15:00 NY and flatten15:55 are explicit CFD session adaptations; maximum holding1h.
First-tick ORB crossing approximated with M1 OHLC crossing and stop-first ordering.
Fixed daily ATR uses prior14 complete RTH true ranges; earlier broker M5 bars are warmup only.
M1 spread is a within-bar proxy, not historical executable ask data. Commission omitted because unknown, not assumed zero for tradability.
No equity, position sizing, margin, portfolio allocation, daily-loss or drawdown-halt simulation. R drawdown is closed-outcome diagnostic, not account drawdown.
Minimum-lot risk illustration uses current metadata, not historical admissibility. No execution risk gate is opened.
